prompt: Dark wide scene rendered with physically based lighting: a vast quiet interior in the colour #06121c, its back wall covered by a faint grid of tiny evenly spaced dots that fades softly into darkness toward the edges, and a floor of still dark water, mirror-smooth, that reflects everything standing on it. In the right half, from the right edge to the middle, a tall open threshold stands in the shallow water, centred a quarter of the way in from the right edge, its top a fifth of the way down from the top edge: a thick frame with softly rounded corners and real depth, cut from polished white marble with fine soft grey veins and a satin sheen, seen in slight three-quarter perspective so that its left side face is visible. Its inner edge is finished with a thin chamfered rim of brushed steel, a continuous recessed seam of white light runs along the inside of the frame like a modern light fixture, and a few precise hairline joints cross the stone. Through the opening pours an aurora: tall curtains of light in turquoise #1aa6df and #5cc8f2, soft green #2F7A55 and violet #3D6FD9 that ripple vertically like a northern sky, their colours blending into one another, spilling toward the left as a soft volumetric beam through fine floating dust. Three small soft points of light hover inside the opening at different depths, each trailing a short faint wake: one in #E0703A, one in #2F7A55 and one in #3D6FD9. The water reflects the aurora as long trembling streaks of turquoise, green and violet, broken by soft concentric ripples spreading from the base of the threshold, under a crisp mirror reflection of the white marble frame. The glow rises into a radial halo that fades before the middle of the frame. The left half, from the left edge to the middle, is the same dark wall and dark still water in #06121c, smooth and even in tone with only the faint dot grid and the faintest coloured sheen on the water at its far edge, kept clear for legibility. Style: elegant digital art, physically based rendering, soft volumetric light, crisp reflections, polished marble and brushed metal, smooth gradients, fine material detail. Colours: #06121c, #1aa6df, #5cc8f2, #2F7A55, #3D6FD9, #E0703A, #ffffff highlights. Mood: honest, quietly ambitious, inviting. The image is completely textless.
